```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
options(error = rlang::entrace, rlang_backtrace_on_error = "full")
library(tidyverse)
plants <- read.csv("tabular_data/Howe_Sound_vascular_plant_records_consolidated_2024-11-labels.csv")
plant.summary <- read.csv("tabular_data/vascular_plant_summary_resynthesized_2024-11-14.csv", fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
new <- plant.summary %>% filter(str_detect(reportingStatus, "new"))
confirmed <- plant.summary %>% filter(reportingStatus == 'confirmed')
reported <- plant.summary %>% filter(reportingStatus == 'reported')
observed <- plant.summary %>% filter(iNatObservationStatus == 'observed')
```

## Community contributions to our knowledge of the regional plant diversity

Through the combined efforts of `r length(unique(plants$recordedBy))` individuals, the Átl’ḵa7tsem/Howe Sound naturalist
community has now documented a total of `r nrow(plant.summary)` vascular plant species. Based on search
efforts over the last decade, `r round((nrow(confirmed)/(nrow(confirmed)+nrow(reported))*100), digits = 0)` percent
of the historically reported plant diversity has been confirmed and `r nrow(new)` new species reports added to the
list.

Community members have now documented `r round((nrow(observed)/(nrow(plant.summary))*100), digits = 0)` percent of the
total plant diversity known to the region on iNaturalist.

Contribute to this growing record by submitting your observations to the
[Átl’ḵa7tsem/Howe Sound Biosphere Region iNaturalist project](https://www.inaturalist.org/projects/atl-ka7tsem-howe-sound-biosphere-region).

Here, you can browse photos of some of the most commonly documented plants, as well as recent observations and
top observers across the region, based on [iNaturalist](http://inaturalist.org/) data.
Visualisation code courtesy of [Ben Keen](https://github.com/benkeen).
